method: Safety-separated authority Tools are not merged merely because schemas overlap.
Projection-only and reconciling operations remain distinct.
Operator/recovery Tools may have zero repository consumers and still be necessary.
A Tool becomes a removal candidate only if a mature replacement preserves assumptions, guarantees, replay/recovery semantics and current consumers.

tools.uniqueContract: read-only capability/projection boundary; admission still rebinds current truth
tools.reason: runtime discovery cannot be inferred safely from config or client memory

tools.uniqueContract: creates isolated detached Git authority with explicit response-loss reconciliation handle
tools.reason: no other Tool creates Workspace identity

tools.uniqueContract: exact Workspace proof/reconnect boundary
tools.reason: list intentionally omits exact proof by default

tools.uniqueContract: inventory/discovery of open Workspaces with pagination
tools.reason: zero external refs does not remove operator/reconnect discovery need

tools.uniqueContract: bounded UTF-8 workspace observation
tools.reason: high real consumer use; not replaceable by artifact.read

tools.uniqueContract: digest-bound native MCP image transport
tools.reason: binary/media perceptual transport is not UTF-8 read

tools.uniqueContract: bounded/paged structured change-set primitive
tools.reason: designed replacement for unbounded legacy path arrays

tools.uniqueContract: Git patch text plus rename/copy interpretation
tools.reason: explicitly legacy convenience; retire only after all consumers can use changes + another patch-text primitive

tools.uniqueContract: atomic digest-fenced synchronous local file mutation
tools.reason: not safe for durable response-loss workflows; do not widen; reconsider after mature exec-based editing fully covers interactive use

tools.uniqueContract: source-state compare-and-close with physical dependency fence/tombstone replay

tools.reason: main cross-owner execution waist

tools.uniqueContract: immutable inputs with explicit trusted-local Linux ambient authority
tools.reason: low usage but distinct high-authority contract; do not merge by usage count

tools.reason: currently no external consumer/live authority, but unique secret-safety contract; re-evaluate only if credential capability itself is retired

tools.uniqueContract: ordered fail-fast multi-step execution inside one Job/Attempt
tools.reason: retain only as bounded sequential physical plan; reject branching/workflow expansion

tools.uniqueContract: projection-only exact durable Job inspection
tools.reason: must remain separate from observe because get cannot reconcile/dispatch

tools.uniqueContract: targeted reconciliation/wait of one committed Job
tools.reason: semantically distinct from projection-only get

tools.uniqueContract: durable cancel intent + physical process-tree stop + reconciliation
tools.reason: cannot be emulated by client cancellation

tools.uniqueContract: response-loss/reconnect discovery by workspaceId/clientRequestId
tools.reason: zero current external refs does not remove recovery requirement

tools.uniqueContract: bounded verified range from exact Runtime Artifact
tools.reason: required to retrieve retained output/result/evidence without bloating Job projection

tools.uniqueContract: exact external-file ingress into explicitly enabled InputAuthority
tools.reason: disabled by default; unique external ingress safety boundary

tools.uniqueContract: only graduated structured reconciliable external effect: Runtime self-release
tools.reason: operator use is not measured by source refs; receipt semantics unique

tools.uniqueContract: projection-only authoritative release receipt readback
tools.reason: required after transport loss/self-replacement

conclusion: No public Tool should be deleted in RW0. Internal execution variants should converge through AuthorityContract/OperationCircuitCompiler first. Re-evaluate workspace.diff after consumer migration; keep workspace.mutate narrow and non-durable unless a replacement proves equivalent.
